[[File:Blixus.jpg|thumb|right|150px|[[Blixus/Legends|Blixus]] were a form of cephalopod.]]
'''Cephalopods''' were typically [[Water/Legends|water]]-based or [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] creatures sporting tentacles,<ref name="NEGAS">''[[The New Essential Guide to Alien Species]]''</ref> though some exceptions occurred, such as the [[arboreal octopus]] of [[Cholganna/Legends|Cholganna]]. The [[ibliton]] of [[Randorn 2]] was a cephalopod-[[Crustacean/Legends|crustacean]] [[Hybrid/Legends|hybrid]].<ref name="CotG">''[[Creatures of the Galaxy]]''</ref>
